question: Which of the following parts of a vapour compression system allows the liquid refrigerant under high pressure and temperature to pass at a controlled rate after reducing its pressure and temperature?
solution:
The correct answer is __Expansion valve.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Expansion valve__ is a crucial component of a vapour compression system.
 
• The expansion valve reduces the pressure and temperature of the liquid refrigerant.
 
• It allows the refrigerant to pass at a controlled rate into the evaporator.
 
• The sudden drop in pressure enables the refrigerant to absorb heat from the surrounding environment during evaporation.
 
• This component ensures the proper functioning and efficiency of the refrigeration cycle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Evaporator:**

 
 
• The evaporator is responsible for absorbing heat from the space to be cooled.
 
• It allows the refrigerant to evaporate, changing from liquid to gas.
 
 
 
• **Receiver:**
 
 
• The receiver stores the high-pressure liquid refrigerant from the condenser.
 
• It ensures a steady supply of liquid refrigerant to the expansion valve.
 
 
 
• **Condenser:**
 
 
• The condenser rejects heat from the refrigerant to the external environment.
 
• It converts the refrigerant from a gas to a liquid under high pressure.
